entries.displayName: Convert files to Markdown — Agent Skill
entries.description: Instructions for converting DOCX, PDF, XLSX, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML and images (OCR) to clean Markdown without uploading files.
representativeQueries: convert this Word document to Markdown
turn a PDF into Markdown I can paste into GitHub
extract the text from a scanned document
how do I convert files to Markdown without uploading them

entries.description: Model Context Protocol server exposing local file conversion to Markdown. Runs over stdio via npx; no hosted endpoint.
representativeQueries: convert a local file to Markdown from my agent
add a Markdown conversion tool to Claude Code
MCP server that reads DOCX and PDF

entries.description: Tools registered on navigator.modelContext when https://www.convertertomarkdown.com is open, for agents operating the page.

tools.name: convert_text_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert an HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, Markdown or plain-text snippet into clean Markdown.

tools.name: convert_url_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public http(s) URL — page, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV or image — and convert it to Markdown. Maximum 20 MB.

representativeQueries: convert this HTML snippet to Markdown
turn this CSV into a Markdown table
read that web page as Markdown
convert the linked PDF to Markdown
